description.en: Import Jira tickets using custom JQL; create missing status columns automatically.
description.zh-TW: 使用自訂 JQL 匯入 Jira 工作項目，自動建立缺少的狀態欄位。

description.en: Self-hosted Jira Server/Data Center uses PAT with REST v2 (default). Jira Cloud uses OAuth with REST v3.
description.zh-TW: 自架 Jira Server／Data Center 使用 PAT 與 REST v2（預設）；Jira Cloud 使用 OAuth 與 REST v3。

label.zh-TW: Jira Cloud REST v3（OAuth Bearer 權杖）
label.en: Jira Cloud REST v3 (OAuth bearer token)

description.en: HTTPS API base URL without /rest/api. Self-hosted: https://jira.example.com, including any /jira context path; add a custom HTTPS port when needed, for example https://jira.example.com:8443/jira (Jira's plain-HTTP port 8080 is not supported). Cloud: https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>. Approve its hostname (without the port) separately; the token is scoped to /rest/api/2 and /rest/api/3 beneath this URL.
description.zh-TW: HTTPS API 基底網址，不含 /rest/api。自架：https://jira.example.com，請包含 /jira 等站台路徑；需要時可加上自訂 HTTPS 連接埠，例如 https://jira.example.com:8443/jira（不支援 Jira 預設的 HTTP 8080 連接埠）。Cloud：https://api.atlassian.com/ex/jira/<cloudId>。需另外核准主機名稱（不含連接埠）；權杖僅傳送至此網址下的 /rest/api/2 與 /rest/api/3。

description.en: HTTPS Jira site URL used for links and stable identities. Self-hosted: same as API base URL, including any context path and custom port. Cloud: https://your-team.atlassian.net. Enter the site root, not a /browse link. Keep this value stable between syncs: changing the host, port or path creates new cards (letter case and an explicit :443 do not).
description.zh-TW: 用於連結與識別的 HTTPS Jira 站台網址。自架：與 API 基底網址相同，包含站台路徑與自訂連接埠；Cloud：https://your-team.atlassian.net。請填站台根網址，不要填 /browse 連結。請在各次同步間維持相同網址：變更主機、連接埠或路徑會建立新卡片（大小寫與明確的 :443 不影響）。

label.zh-TW: Jira 網站網址（ticket 連結）

description.en: JQL query selecting tickets, for example project = APP AND fixVersion = "1.2.0". Missing Jira status columns are created automatically; duplicate matching column names fail the sync. Tickets that stop matching remain on the board. For self-hosted Jira, JQL without ORDER BY is sorted by issue key to keep pagination stable.
description.zh-TW: 篩選 Jira 工作項目的 JQL，例如 project = APP AND fixVersion = "1.2.0"。缺少的狀態欄位會自動建立；同名欄位重複會導致同步失敗。不再符合查詢的卡片會保留在看板。自架 Jira 的 JQL 若沒有 ORDER BY，會自動依 issue key 排序以確保分頁穩定。

description.en: Customize imported card descriptions with {url}, {description}, {key}, and {summary}. Unknown placeholders remain literal. An empty template imports an empty description. Manual card edits are preserved by Cardbe on later syncs.
description.zh-TW: 使用 {url}、{description}、{key}、{summary} 自訂匯入的卡片描述。未知的佔位符會保留原文；空白模板會匯入空白描述。Cardbe 會保留卡片上的手動修改。

description.en: Self-hosted Jira requires a personal access token (PAT); Cloud requires an OAuth access token with Jira read permissions. Email plus API token (Basic auth) is unsupported. Cardbe sends the token only to the approved Base URL host under /rest/api/2 or /rest/api/3; the plugin never receives it.
description.zh-TW: 自架 Jira 使用個人存取權杖（PAT）；Cloud 使用具備 Jira 讀取權限的 OAuth 存取權杖。不支援電子郵件搭配 API token 的 Basic 驗證。Cardbe 僅傳送至已核准的 API 基底網址主機下的 /rest/api/2 或 /rest/api/3；插件不會取得權杖。

label.en: Bearer token (self-hosted PAT or Cloud OAuth)
label.zh-TW: Bearer token（自架 PAT 或 Cloud OAuth）
